card.name: Space or comma before a 1900s year
card.fires_on: The space or comma right before a four-digit year starting with 19 (or 18) in citations and dates. It marks the point where the year's first digits come next.

modes.label: Citation year
modes.description: The gap after a journal or book citation just before the publication year.

modes.label: Year after 'in'
modes.description: The space after 'in' just before a year in running prose about events.
modes.example: UN's 50th Anniversary In commemoration of the United Nation's 50th anniversary in<< >>1995

modes.label: Date with comma
modes.description: The comma after a day and month, before the year.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward year digits like 19xx, although the promoted tokens look unrelated.
card.plain: It fires just before a year from the 1800s or 1900s is written, mostly in references.
